jobs.title: Studentische Hilfskraft (d/m/w) im Referat Forschungsförderung und wissenschaftliches Berichtswesen
jobs.reason: This is an explicit studentische Hilfskraft (working-student) role, which is excluded by policy regardless of field. It is also a data-entry / research-information-system administrative post oriented toward information-science students, not a research role.

jobs.title: Restaurator:in (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: Requires a completed university degree in Conservation/Restoration plus professional experience as a restorer specialising in painted wooden sculptures — an essential qualification the candidate does not hold. The role is entirely outside the candidate's field and skill set.
jobs.salary: Up to EG 12 TVöD Bund, depending on qualification and experience

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) - Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L (DLR Satellite Hacking Challenge / Space Cybersecurity)
jobs.reason: The essential profile requires a Master's in aerospace engineering, computer science or computer engineering plus knowledge of embedded/satellite systems, CTF competitions, RF/SDR and binary exploitation — deep-technical requirements far beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and IR background. This is a hard skills mismatch and topically outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (PostDoc) (d/m/w) - 2. Qualifizierungsphase (zur Habilitation)
jobs.reason: A PostDoc position that requires an already-completed doctorate (Promotion) in engineering, mathematics or physics — a qualification the candidate does not hold. It further demands deep CFD/OpenFOAM expertise and C/C++ programming, entirely outside the candidate's field. Multiple hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Referent*in Transformation der Chemieindustrie (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: This is not an entry-level role: it requires established expertise and resilient networks in industrial and chemicals policy plus experience in national and European lobbying — a substantive experience profile the candidate lacks. The chemical-industry transformation topic also sits well outside the candidate's international law / security / atrocity-prevention interest zones.

jobs.title: Senior Netzwerkadministrator:in (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: This is a "Senior" IT role requiring a computer-science degree and several years of hands-on experience administering complex networks (Cisco, routing, switching, firewalls) — a deep-technical infrastructure profile the candidate does not hold, plus a senior title. Entirely outside the candidate's research/policy background and interest zones.

jobs.title: Facility Management Support (m/w/d) - Job-ID 0005V_2026
jobs.reason: Requires a completed craft/technical vocational training (Berufsausbildung) such as carpenter, electrician or building technician, which is an essential the candidate does not hold. This is a hands-on facility/building-maintenance role with no research or policy content, entirely outside the candidate's profile despite the institution's Holocaust-memory mission.

jobs.title: Leitung Bereich Studienwerk (w/m/d/k.A.)
jobs.reason: This is a senior division-head ("Leitung") role that essentially requires a completed doctorate ("Promotion") and several years of management and personnel-leadership experience at head-of-division level — three separate hard disqualifiers. Although higher-education policy overlaps with the candidate's background, the level and qualification requirements are far beyond an early-career profile.

jobs.title: Research Associate — PhD Position "Phase Retrieval in Imaging and Speech Enhancement" (DASHH Graduate School)
jobs.reason: This is a funded PhD in computer science / applied mathematics on signal processing (phase retrieval, imaging, speech enhancement), whose essential requirements — a background in natural/computer/engineering sciences or applied maths and a strong programming/software-development record — are well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and social-science profile. Although funded PhDs are welcome in principle, this one falls squarely in the deep-technical zone the candidate cannot meet, and it is outside all interest areas.

jobs.title: Sachbearbeitung (m/w/d) – Regionalbüro Bremen|Hamburg|Schleswig-Holstein
jobs.reason: This is an administrative/clerical role (Sachbearbeitung) that requires a completed commercial vocational training (Kaufmann/frau für Büromanagement) and long-standing experience in event management and financial administration as essentials — neither of which the candidate holds. It is an administrative-support post rather than a research or policy role, so it is a poor fit even setting aside the qualification gap.

jobs.title: Sachbearbeitung (m/w/d) im Landesbüro Brandenburg
jobs.reason: The role requires an essential completed commercial vocational training (Ausbildung zum Kaufmann/-frau für Büromanagement) plus demonstrated experience in financial administration, procurement law and event management — administrative/clerical qualifications and specialisms the candidate does not hold. This is an administrative back-office position outside the candidate's research/analysis profile and interest zones, and the essential Ausbildung requirement gates it.

jobs.title: SAR Team Lead/Deck Rating (f/m/d) (September)
jobs.reason: This is a maritime search-and-rescue operational role requiring essential nautical qualifications the candidate plainly lacks — RYA Powerboat Level 2, STCW safety training, 200+ hours boat-driving experience, and proven leadership of a rescue team under pressure. It is also a Team Lead position and a hands-on operational-safety role entirely outside the candidate's research/policy profile.
jobs.type: Full-time (2 months on / 2 months off rotation)
